title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the qualities of a noble-hearted person
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting that purity of heart, a spirit of sacrifice, courage, equanimity in joy and sorrow, competence, affection and truthfulness are the defining qualities of a noble-hearted person and an exceptional personality. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam- “शुचित्वं त्यागिता शौर्यं सामान्यं सुखदुःखयोः। दाक्षिण्यं चानुरक्तिश्च सत्यता च सुहृद्गुणाः॥” The Subhashitam conveys that purity of heart, a spirit of sacrifice, courage, equanimity in both joy and sorrow, competence, affection and truthfulness-these are not merely the qualities of an ordinary friend but rather the defining traits of a person endowed with a noble heart and an exceptional personality. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “शुचित्वं त्यागिता शौर्यं सामान्यं सुखदुःखयोः। दाक्षिण्यं चानुरक्तिश्च सत्यता च सुहृद्गुणाः॥”
शुचित्वं त्यागिता शौर्यं सामान्यं सुखदुःखयोः।

दाक्षिण्यं चानुरक्तिश्च सत्यता च सुहृद्गुणाः॥ https://t.co/vKvqfnXsCm — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 5, 2026
